meta.name: gif-sticker-maker
meta.description: Convert photos into four animated GIF stickers with captions. Use when the user wants cartoon stickers, animated avatars, emoji packs, or short Funko/Pop-Mart-style reaction GIFs from a source image.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将照片转换成带文字的动画GIF贴纸
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把普通照片变成有趣动画贴纸
copy.tagline_en: Turn photos into animated GIF stickers with captions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to transform ordinary photos into fun animated stickers

howto.what: 安装后，当你提供一张源图片时，Claude会生成4个带字幕的动画GIF贴纸。它会先确认字幕（或使用默认），然后生成静态图、转为动画并交付GIF文件。
howto.when: 当你想要卡通贴纸、动画头像、表情包或从图片制作短Funko/Pop-Mart风格反应GIF时触发。

say.text: 用这张照片做一套表情包贴纸，加常用字幕。
把我的头像做成动画反应GIF。
say.note: Claude基于头像制作动画贴纸。

say.text: 从这张图生成4个带‘哈哈’、‘无语’字幕的GIF。

howto.what_en: When you provide a source image, Claude generates four animated GIF stickers with captions. It confirms captions (or uses defaults), creates static sticker images, animates them into videos, then converts to GIFs and delivers the final assets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want cartoon stickers, animated avatars, emoji packs, or short Funko/Pop-Mart-style reaction GIFs from a source image.

say_en.text: Turn this photo into a sticker pack with common captions.
Make my avatar into animated reaction GIFs.
say_en.note: Claude creates animated stickers from avatar.

say_en.text: Generate 4 GIFs with 'haha' and 'speechless' captions from this image.
